svg.aria-label: synthwerk-contracts is the one contract of Synthwerk: OpenAPI 3.1 for HTTP, CloudEvents 1.0.2 with JSON Schema for events. CI generates the Go and TypeScript clients and fails every pull request that breaks a consumer. It runs nothing. It only makes promises.
